svg.text: Paired-dummy current replenisher | one flat cell | REPLENISH_CANCEL_V1
Shared VPB/VCAS and dummy reference stay outside. EN=0 steers to DUMMY; EN=1 delivers positive current at OUT.
MATCHED STEERING / ISOLATION WITH INTERNAL CANCELLATION
Multiplicities match the physical edge-unit inventory.
Main steering and isolation pairs use AB/BA rows with coincident centroids.
Cancellation retains one minimum-width unit per branch.
OUT current replenishes negative detector charge.
No normal-operation reset path across Cf.
Matched branches and cancellation are literal transistor devices in this flat module.
